questions.stem: Cells seen in chronic infection of pseudomonas:-
questions.solutionHtml:
Neutrophils
  1. Acute inflammation: mediator is Neutrophils (except in typhoid which are lymphocytes).
  2. Chronic inflammation: mediators are lymphocytes, macrophages, and plasma cells (except in chronic pseudomonas which is neutrophils).


Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 79, 83, 84.
